name: VPN keeps dropping (team affected)
subject: VPN disconnects every few minutes
body: Hi, this is Anita Rao from the finance team at Northwind Traders. Since yesterday's update the GlobalConnect VPN drops every 5 minutes for all 12 people in our team, so we cannot reach the ERP system. Month-end closing is due tomorrow. Please call me on +971 50 123 4567 or email anita.rao@northwind-traders.com.

name: Charged twice for subscription
subject: Duplicate charge on my card
body: Hello, I was charged twice for our annual Pro subscription renewal on 3 November. Account number ACC-778812. Please refund the duplicate payment as soon as possible. Regards, Daniel Mathew

name: Production outage (critical)
subject: URGENT: customer portal down
body: Our customer portal hosted with you has been returning error 503 since 02:00. All of our customers are affected and we are losing orders. The status page shows nothing. Please treat this as critical.

name: Locked out of account
subject: Account locked
body: I tried to log in this morning and my account is locked after a few wrong passwords. I have a client presentation in two hours and need access to my email. My username is j.fernandes.

name: Cracked laptop screen
subject: Broken laptop screen
body: I dropped my laptop and the screen is cracked. It is a TechServ-supplied ThinkPad, serial PF3XK21. Is this covered by warranty, and can I get a loan laptop meanwhile?

name: Quote for extra licences
subject: Pricing for 50 more licences
body: We would like to add 50 licences to our current plan from next quarter. Could you send us a quote and let us know if there is a volume discount?
